variants.prompt:
Edit the attached EVO BASE FISH to create ONE superb finished 2D game character asset for the FIN evolution branch. The reference fish's identity must remain unmistakable: same stout slate-blue/silver oval body, silver belly, smooth unarmoured compact head, small jaw with just the same three tiny teeth, same large cream-and-black circular eye and highlight, same simple integrated dark gill fold. The body and head proportions remain the base fish, NOT a new long slender species. ONLY the fins and caudal tail fin evolve; no skull armour, no larger teeth or mouth, no scale armour, no horns. Preserve the handmade game art exactly: very dark navy organically inked silhouette, softly brushed broad light/shadow masses, ivory-grey slightly translucent membranes, a few elegant darker fin rays, restrained painterly texture and clear readable silhouettes at 90 pixels. Fins must grow from anatomically coherent locations with visible continuous bases and delicate pale membranes; no detached parts or arbitrary extra appendages.

Strict orthographic SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT, horizontal neutral swimming pose, head at RIGHT and tail at LEFT. Swept-back tips point toward the tail at LEFT. Pectoral fin connects behind/below gill. Anatomical fin architecture must look purposefully evolved for control and propulsion, powerful and elegant, NOT a decorative fantasy betta or lionfish. No spiky armour, no threadlike ornamental streamers, no bat wings, no feathers, no limbs or legs. Show each new structure in silhouette rather than hiding all changes on the body. Keep the characteristic pale fins, with darker cool shaded roots and the same hand-drawn black-blue edge. Fins of different functions should have coherent structural hierarchy, not all simply enlarged copies.

One entire fish including all fin tips and full caudal tail inside the canvas, generous empty margin around every extremity, no clipping. Prefer the same 1675 x 939 landscape canvas; fit the complete fin silhouette with at least 6-8% transparent margin, uniformly repositioning/reframing the whole fish if needed rather than deforming its body. Real transparent ALPHA background, no coloured backdrop, no glow or outside shadow, no water, no floating particles, no text, no labels, no comparison panels, no watermark. High-resolution clean single character master illustration, no rig or detached components.

STAGE ONE, FINS GREATER THAN 20: First clear evolutionary upgrade, still compact. Enlarge the visible pectoral fin into a firm broad tapered paddle, approximately 1.4 times the base fin area, with a gracefully swept pointed tip toward the lower LEFT. Its root remains at the base fish's shoulder. The ventral pelvic fin is more substantial and tapered. The existing single dorsal fin becomes a broad low swept-back triangular blade, with a rounded leading edge and trailing point directed toward the LEFT. The caudal fin has a slightly larger span and a deeper clean V fork, with two strong tapered ivory lobes. One dorsal fin only at this first tier. No extra finlets yet. A simple clean functional silhouette: same fish with a clearly upgraded steering/propulsion system, restrained confident shapes. Do not make the giant tall crescent tail of the final stage.
